induction.theorem: Init /\ [][Next]_vars => []Safety for the intact modeled transitions, for every natural Capacity and MaxOps.

scopeAndRemainingLimits: The finite and inductive results concern modeled transitions, abstract cryptography and atomic durable writes. Induction removes trace-length and natural capacity/operation bounds, not the three succession identities or the specified socket/replay state shapes. No whole-program TypeScript refinement or unconditional liveness theorem.

The eleven TypeScript guard equivalences are for parsed inputs under the stated primitive assumptions. They do not prove that every caller validates its inputs, that all mutation sites use those guards, or that the primitives are secure.

Two new isolated browser failures have demonstrated causes and fixes. The earlier uninstrumented production timeout cannot retrospectively be attributed to either. Ordinary private-room actions were exercised in production; no production fault or capacity experiment.

The 24 edition-12 trials test specified interruptions on one machine and are not a population false-offer rate, WAN benchmark, physical laptop sleep/wake measurement or promise about a particular idle agent harness. A malicious relay can delay, omit or initiate an unnecessary offer; it cannot produce a member’s consent.
No independent security audit, crash model of all browser/OS/storage implementations, or proof about compromised endpoints, erasure or actual human behavior.

reproduce.archive: From an empty directory: extract each listed source archive there in the order above using tar -xzf "$archive" --strip-components=1. The second archive only overlays verification assets. Run the following commands from that directory. Use separate output directories for trials.
install: npx playwright install chromium firefox webkit
methods: Use the exact TLAPM release and Z3 4.13.3 checksums in .github/workflows/protocol-induction.yml.
reproduce.timingStudy: Use the edition-12 source and browser assets identified in evidence/qualification-r12/qualification.json, not the current browser. Read its trial definitions and reporting clock before comparing times.
reproduce.publicServices: Live evidence is in deployment.json; laboratory checks require no production credentials. Do not inject faults into public rooms.
